objects.name: vi_balance
objects.view_sql:
WITH j AS (
         SELECT p.id,
            p.scenario_id,
            p.model_id,
            p.company_id,
            p.company_name,
            p.model_name,
            p.scenario_name,
            p.is_base,
            p.sort,
            p.year,
            p.np_parent,
            p.dividend,
            p.minority,
            p.payout,
            p.pretax,
            p.interest,
            p.depreciation,
            p.debt_close,
            f.maint_capex + f.growth_capex AS capex_total,
            f.noncash_gain_deduct - f.investee_cash_div AS lt_change,
            m.opening_op_assets,
            m.opening_lt_invest,
            m.opening_equity,
            m.opening_minority,
            m.opening_debt
           FROM vi_projection p
             JOIN vi_forecast_base f ON f.model_id = p.model_id AND f.year = p.year
             JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = p.model_id
        ), c AS (
         SELECT j.id,
            j.scenario_id,
            j.model_id,
            j.company_id,
            j.company_name,
            j.model_name,
            j.scenario_name,
            j.is_base,
            j.sort,
            j.year,
            j.np_parent,
            j.dividend,
            j.minority,
            j.payout,
            j.pretax,
            j.interest,
            j.depreciation,
            j.debt_close,
            j.capex_total,
            j.lt_change,
            j.opening_op_assets,
            j.opening_lt_invest,
            j.opening_equity,
            j.opening_minority,
            j.opening_debt,
            j.opening_op_assets + sum(j.capex_total - j.depreciation) OVER w AS op_assets_close,
            j.opening_lt_invest + sum(j.lt_change) OVER w AS lt_invest_close,
            j.opening_equity + sum(j.np_parent - j.dividend) OVER w AS equity_close,
            j.opening_minority + sum(j.minority * (1::double precision - j.payout)) OVER w AS minority_close
           FROM j
          WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY j.scenario_id ORDER BY j.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
        ), d AS (
         SELECT c.id,
            c.scenario_id,
            c.model_id,
            c.company_id,
            c.company_name,
            c.model_name,
            c.scenario_name,
            c.is_base,
            c.sort,
            c.year,
            c.np_parent,
            c.dividend,
            c.minority,
            c.payout,
            c.pretax,
            c.interest,
            c.depreciation,
            c.debt_close,
            c.capex_total,
            c.lt_change,
            c.opening_op_assets,
            c.opening_lt_invest,
            c.opening_equity,
            c.opening_minority,
            c.opening_debt,
            c.op_assets_close,
            c.lt_invest_close,
            c.equity_close,
            c.minority_close,
            COALESCE(lag(c.op_assets_close) OVER s, c.opening_op_assets) AS op_assets_open,
            COALESCE(lag(c.equity_close) OVER s, c.opening_equity) AS equity_open,
            c.equity_close + c.minority_close + c.debt_close - c.op_assets_close - c.lt_invest_close AS other_net_assets
           FROM c
          WINDOW s AS (PARTITION BY c.scenario_id ORDER BY c.year)
        )
 SELECT id,
    scenario_id,
    model_id,
    company_id,
    company_name,
    model_name,
    scenario_name,
    is_base,
    sort,
    year,
    op_assets_open,
    capex_total,
    depreciation,
    op_assets_close,
    lt_invest_close,
    debt_close,
    equity_open,
    np_parent,
    dividend,
    equity_close,
    minority_close,
    other_net_assets,
    other_net_assets - COALESCE(lag(other_net_assets) OVER s, opening_equity + opening_minority + opening_debt - opening_op_assets - opening_lt_invest) AS other_net_change,
    np_parent / NULLIF((equity_open + equity_close) / 2::double precision, 0::double precision) AS roe,
    debt_close / NULLIF(debt_close + equity_close + minority_close, 0::double precision) AS debt_to_capital,
    (pretax + interest) / NULLIF(interest, 0::double precision) AS interest_cover,
    debt_close / NULLIF(pretax + interest + depreciation, 0::double precision) AS debt_to_ebitda
   FROM d
  WINDOW s AS (PARTITION BY scenario_id ORDER BY year);

objects.name: vi_check
objects.view_sql:
WITH m AS (
         SELECT m.id,
            m.name AS model_name,
            m.company_id,
            co.name AS company_name,
            m.base_year AS b,
            m.terminal_year AS t,
            m.rf,
            mc.latest_rf,
            mc.latest_rf_date,
            mc.years_elapsed,
            cc.latest_price_date
           FROM vi_model_base m
             JOIN vi_model_calc mc ON mc.id = m.id
             LEFT JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id
             LEFT JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id
          WHERE m.status = '当前'::text
        ), vb AS (
         SELECT vi_valuation.id,
            vi_valuation.model_id,
            vi_valuation.company_id,
            vi_valuation.company_name,
            vi_valuation.model_name,
            vi_valuation.scenario_name,
            vi_valuation.is_base,
            vi_valuation.sort,
            vi_valuation.discount_rate,
            vi_valuation.terminal_growth,
            vi_valuation.value_base_date,
            vi_valuation.value_today,
            vi_valuation.cash_value_today,
            vi_valuation.pv_explicit,
            vi_valuation.terminal_pv,
            vi_valuation.terminal_share,
            vi_valuation.market_price,
            vi_valuation.market_date,
            vi_valuation.price_vs_value,
            vi_valuation.watch_low,
            vi_valuation.watch_high,
            vi_valuation.years_complete,
            vi_valuation.cash_years,
            vi_valuation.required_return,
            vi_valuation.value_at_required,
            vi_valuation.implied_irr,
            vi_valuation.cash_implied_irr,
            vi_valuation.irr_spread,
            vi_valuation.conclusion
           FROM vi_valuation
          WHERE vi_valuation.is_base
        ), sb AS (
         SELECT vi_sotp.id,
            vi_sotp.model_id,
            vi_sotp.company_id,
            vi_sotp.company_name,
            vi_sotp.model_name,
            vi_sotp.scenario_name,
            vi_sotp.is_base,
            vi_sotp.sort,
            vi_sotp.core_year,
            vi_sotp.as_of,
            vi_sotp.core_pretax,
            vi_sotp.core_earnings,
            vi_sotp.discount_rate,
            vi_sotp.terminal_growth,
            vi_sotp.ronic,
            vi_sotp.formula_multiple,
            vi_sotp.multiple,
            vi_sotp.core_value,
            vi_sotp.segments_value,
            vi_sotp.mature_value,
            vi_sotp.mature_earnings,
            vi_sotp.mature_multiple,
            vi_sotp.growth_value,
            vi_sotp.invest_value,
            vi_sotp.direct_value,
            vi_sotp.mature_earn_pv,
            vi_sotp.mature_interim_pv,
            vi_sotp.cash,
            vi_sotp.debt,
            vi_sotp.op_cash,
            vi_sotp.repatriation,
            vi_sotp.usable_net_cash,
            vi_sotp.investments,
            vi_sotp.minority_other,
            vi_sotp.noncore,
            vi_sotp.equity_value,
            vi_sotp.shares,
            vi_sotp.value_per_share,
            vi_sotp.value_per_share_quote,
            vi_sotp.market_price,
            vi_sotp.price_vs_value,
            vi_sotp.implied_core_multiple,
            vi_sotp.implied_mature_multiple,
            vi_sotp.implied_growth_value,
            vi_sotp.probability,
            vi_sotp.weighted_value,
            vi_sotp.ddm_value,
            vi_sotp.diff_vs_ddm,
            vi_sotp.watch_low,
            vi_sotp.watch_high,
            vi_sotp.conclusion
           FROM vi_sotp
          WHERE vi_sotp.is_base
        ), c AS (
         SELECT m.id,
            m.model_name,
            m.company_id,
            m.company_name,
            m.b,
            m.t,
            m.rf,
            m.latest_rf,
            m.latest_rf_date,
            m.years_elapsed,
            m.latest_price_date,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_forecast_base f
                  WHERE f.model_id = m.id AND f.year >= (m.b + 1) AND f.year <= m.t) AS n_fc,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_forecast_base f
                     JOIN vi_forecast_calc fc USING (id)
                  WHERE f.model_id = m.id AND fc.cash_complete) AS n_cash,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_forecast_base f
                  WHERE f.model_id = m.id AND f.cash_status = '建议值待核验'::text) AS n_cash_proposed,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_forecast_base f
                  WHERE f.model_id = m.id AND COALESCE(f.operating_status, ''::text) <> '已核验'::text) AS n_op_unverified,
            ( SELECT string_agg(s.name, '、'::text) AS string_agg
                   FROM vi_scenario_base s
                     JOIN vi_scenario_calc sc USING (id)
                  WHERE s.model_id = m.id AND sc.eff_discount_rate <= s.terminal_growth) AS bad_rg,
            ( SELECT min(fc.debt_close) AS min
                   FROM vi_forecast_base f
                     JOIN vi_forecast_calc fc USING (id)
                  WHERE f.model_id = m.id) AS min_debt,
            ( SELECT format('%s→%s'::text, vi_pct(min(f.cost_of_debt) FILTER (WHERE f.year = (m.b + 1)), 2), vi_pct(min(f.cost_of_debt) FILTER (WHERE f.year = m.t), 2)) AS format
                   FROM vi_forecast_base f
                  WHERE f.model_id = m.id) AS cod_path,
            ( SELECT format('%s→%s 亿元'::text, vi_fmt(min(fc.debt_open) FILTER (WHERE f.year = (m.b + 1)), 0), vi_fmt(min(fc.debt_close) FILTER (WHERE f.year = m.t), 0)) AS format
                   FROM vi_forecast_base f
                     JOIN vi_forecast_calc fc USING (id)
                  WHERE f.model_id = m.id) AS debt_path,
            vb.terminal_share AS tv_share,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_collector_base k
                     JOIN vi_collector_calc kc USING (id)
                  WHERE kc.needs_alert) AS n_alert,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_observation_base o
                     JOIN vi_observation_calc oc USING (id)
                     JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id
                  WHERE NOT oc.is_valid AND (mt.company_id = m.company_id OR mt.company_id IS NULL)) AS n_invalid,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_thesis_base th
                     JOIN vi_thesis_calc tc USING (id)
                  WHERE th.company_id = m.company_id AND tc.check_result ~~ '已触发%'::text) AS n_falsified,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_thesis_base th
                     JOIN vi_thesis_calc tc USING (id)
                  WHERE th.company_id = m.company_id AND tc.check_result <> '未设置'::text) AS n_checked,
            vb.implied_irr AS base_irr,
            vb.cash_implied_irr AS base_cash_irr,
            vb.value_at_required AS base_v_req,
            ( SELECT mb.required_return
                   FROM vi_model_base mb
                  WHERE mb.id = m.id) AS req,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_moat_base mo
                  WHERE mo.company_id = m.company_id) AS n_moat,
            ( SELECT format('真实壁垒 %s、局部优势 %s、伪壁垒 %s、待验证 %s'::text, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mo.verdict = '真实壁垒'::text), count(*) FILTER (WHERE mo.verdict = '局部优势'::text), count(*) FILTER (WHERE mo.verdict = '伪壁垒'::text), count(*) FILTER (WHERE mo.verdict IS NULL OR mo.verdict = '待验证'::text)) AS format
                   FROM vi_moat_base mo
                  WHERE mo.company_id = m.company_id) AS moat_mix,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_moat_base mo
                  WHERE mo.company_id = m.company_id AND mo.verdict IS DISTINCT FROM '伪壁垒'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM vi_lnk_moat_theses l
                             JOIN vi_thesis_base t ON t.id = l.thesis_id
                          WHERE l.moat_id = mo.id AND t.debated_on IS NOT NULL))) AS n_moat_undebated,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_moat_base mo
                     JOIN vi_moat_calc mc USING (id)
                  WHERE mo.company_id = m.company_id AND mc.check_result ~~ '已触发%'::text) AS n_moat_broken,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_fit_score_base fs
                  WHERE fs.company_id = m.company_id AND fs.score IS NOT NULL) AS n_fit,
            ( SELECT sum(fs.score) AS sum
                   FROM vi_fit_score_base fs
                  WHERE fs.company_id = m.company_id) AS fit_total,
            ( SELECT string_agg(z.txt, '；'::text ORDER BY z.sort) AS string_agg
                   FROM ( SELECT fs.sort,
                            format('%s %s 分，但 %s'::text, fs.dimension, fs.score, string_agg((t.code || ' '::text) || t.status, '、'::text ORDER BY t.code)) AS txt
                           FROM vi_fit_score_base fs
                             JOIN vi_lnk_fit_score_theses l ON l.fit_score_id = fs.id
                             JOIN vi_thesis_base t ON t.id = l.thesis_id
                          WHERE fs.company_id = m.company_id AND fs.score >= 4 AND (t.status = ANY (ARRAY['存疑'::text, '证伪'::text]))
                          GROUP BY fs.id, fs.sort, fs.dimension, fs.score) z) AS fit_conflict,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_risk_base r
                  WHERE r.company_id = m.company_id) AS n_risk,
            ( SELECT format('重大 %s、重要 %s、一般 %s'::text, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rc.level = '重大'::text), count(*) FILTER (WHERE rc.level = '重要'::text), count(*) FILTER (WHERE rc.level = '一般'::text)) AS format
                   FROM vi_risk_base r
                     JOIN vi_risk_calc rc USING (id)
                  WHERE r.company_id = m.company_id) AS risk_mix,
            ( SELECT string_agg(r.code, '、'::text ORDER BY r.code) AS string_agg
                   FROM vi_risk_base r
                     JOIN vi_risk_calc rc USING (id)
                  WHERE r.company_id = m.company_id AND rc.level = '重大'::text AND COALESCE(r.treatment, '未计入估值'::text) = '未计入估值'::text) AS risk_unpriced,
            ( SELECT string_agg(r.code, '、'::text ORDER BY r.code) AS string_agg
                   FROM vi_risk_base r
                     JOIN vi_risk_calc rc USING (id)
                  WHERE r.company_id = m.company_id AND (rc.level = ANY (ARRAY['重大'::text, '重要'::text])) AND NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.early_warning), ''::text) IS NULL AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM vi_lnk_risk_watches l
                          WHERE l.risk_id = r.id))) AS risk_no_signal,
            ( SELECT string_agg(r.code, '、'::text ORDER BY r.code) AS string_agg
                   FROM vi_risk_base r
                  WHERE r.company_id = m.company_id AND (r.probability IS NULL OR r.impact IS NULL OR r.treatment IS NULL)) AS risk_incomplete,
            sb.value_per_share AS sotp_base,
            sb.diff_vs_ddm AS sotp_diff,
            sb.implied_core_multiple AS sotp_implied,
            sb.multiple AS sotp_multiple,
            vb.value_today AS ddm_base,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_sotp_segment_base g
                  WHERE g.model_id = m.id) AS n_seg,
            sb.mature_value AS seg_mature,
            sb.growth_value AS seg_growth,
            sb.invest_value AS seg_invest,
            sb.direct_value AS seg_direct,
            sb.noncore AS seg_noncore,
            sb.equity_value AS seg_equity,
            sb.implied_growth_value AS seg_implied_growth,
            sb.weighted_value AS seg_weighted,
            sb.mature_multiple AS seg_mature_mult,
            sb.implied_mature_multiple AS seg_implied_mature,
            ( SELECT sum(s.probability) AS sum
                   FROM vi_scenario_base s
                  WHERE s.model_id = m.id) AS prob_sum,
            ( SELECT count(s.probability) AS count
                   FROM vi_scenario_base s
                  WHERE s.model_id = m.id) AS prob_n
           FROM m
             LEFT JOIN vb ON vb.model_id = m.id
             LEFT JOIN sb ON sb.model_id = m.id
        )
 SELECT c.id * 100 + x.k AS id,
    c.id AS model_id,
    c.company_id,
    c.company_name,
    c.model_name,
    x.code,
    x.name,
    x.result,
    x.detail
   FROM c
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (1,'C01'::text,'预测年份完整'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_fc = (c.t - c.b) THEN '通过'::text
                    ELSE '阻断'::text
                END,format('需要 %s—%s 年共 %s 年逐年假设，现有 %s 年'::text, c.b + 1, c.t, c.t - c.b, c.n_fc)), (2,'C02'::text,'折现率大于永续增长率'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.bad_rg IS NULL THEN '通过'::text
                    ELSE '阻断'::text
                END,COALESCE('以下情景 r≤g：'::text || c.bad_rg, '所有情景 r>g'::text)), (3,'C03'::text,'现金桥接'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_cash = (c.t - c.b) AND c.n_cash_proposed = 0 THEN '通过'::text
                    WHEN c.n_cash = (c.t - c.b) THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '阻断'::text
                END,format('完整 %s / %s 年；其中 %s 年为建议值待核验'::text, c.n_cash, c.t - c.b, c.n_cash_proposed)), (4,'C04'::text,'债务滚动'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.min_debt IS NULL THEN '阻断'::text
                    WHEN c.min_debt < 0::double precision THEN '阻断'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,format('带息负债 %s；隐含平均债务成本 %s'::text, c.debt_path, c.cod_path)), (5,'C05'::text,'估值日与基准日'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.years_elapsed > 1.5 THEN '阻断'::text
                    WHEN c.years_elapsed > 0.25 THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,format('距基准日 %s 年。已按折现率把价值滚动到今天；若基准年之后的股息已在今天之前派发，需要从今天价值中扣除。基准日超过 1.5 年应更新模型。'::text, round(c.years_elapsed, 2))), (6,'C06'::text,'股价数据新鲜'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.latest_price_date IS NULL THEN '阻断'::text
                    WHEN (vi_today() - c.latest_price_date) > 7 THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,format('最新股价日期 %s'::text, COALESCE(c.latest_price_date::text, '无'::text))), (7,'C07'::text,'无风险利率参数与最新观察'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.latest_rf IS NULL THEN '提示'::text
                    WHEN abs(c.latest_rf / 100::double precision - c.rf) >= 0.005::double precision THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,format('模型采用 %s；最新观察 %s（%s），相差 %s bp。长期参数不随单日数据自动修改。'::text, vi_pct(c.rf, 2),
                CASE
                    WHEN c.latest_rf IS NULL THEN '—'::text
                    ELSE c.latest_rf::text || '%'::text
                END, COALESCE(c.latest_rf_date::text, '—'::text),
                CASE
                    WHEN c.latest_rf IS NULL THEN '—'::text
                    ELSE round(((c.latest_rf / 100::double precision - c.rf) * 10000::double precision)::numeric)::text
                END)), (8,'C08'::text,'终值依赖度'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.tv_share > 0.7::double precision THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,format('基准情景终值占比 %s（超过 70%% 时价值主要取决于远期假设）'::text, vi_pct(c.tv_share))), (9,'C09'::text,'论点证伪'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_falsified > 0 THEN '阻断'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,format('%s 条论点设置了自动检查，%s 条已触发'::text, c.n_checked, c.n_falsified)), (10,'C10'::text,'经营假设核验'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_op_unverified > 0 THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,format('%s 个年度的经营假设尚未标记为“已核验”'::text, c.n_op_unverified)), (11,'C11'::text,'自动采集健康'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_alert > 0 THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,format('%s 个启用的采集源需要处理'::text, c.n_alert)), (12,'C12'::text,'无效高频数据'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_invalid > 0 THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,format('%s 条观察超出指标合理范围（已排除在计算之外，原值保留）'::text, c.n_invalid)), (13,'C13'::text,'隐含收益率与要求收益率'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.base_irr IS NULL OR c.req IS NULL THEN '提示'::text
                    WHEN c.base_irr >= c.req THEN '通过'::text
                    ELSE '提示'::text
                END,format('按最新市场价买入，基准情景隐含年化收益率 %s（现金支持口径 %s），要求收益率 %s；要求收益率下的最高买入价 %s 元。'::text, vi_pct(c.base_irr, 2), vi_pct(c.base_cash_irr, 2), vi_pct(c.req, 1), vi_fmt(c.base_v_req))), (14,'C14'::text,'竞争壁垒与辩论'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_moat = 0 OR c.n_moat_undebated > 0 OR c.n_moat_broken > 0 THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_moat = 0 THEN '还没有识别竞争壁垒（商业模式分析 / 竞争壁垒）'::text
                    ELSE format('%s 项候选壁垒（%s）；伪壁垒以外还有 %s 项没有关联辩论过的论点（核心论点里填辩论日期并关联壁垒）；壁垒自动检查已触发 %s 项'::text, c.n_moat, c.moat_mix, c.n_moat_undebated, c.n_moat_broken)
                END), (15,'C15'::text,'价值投资适配度'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_fit < 8 OR c.fit_total < 22 THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,format('已评 %s / 8 个维度，总分 %s / 40：%s'::text, c.n_fit, COALESCE(c.fit_total, 0::bigint),
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_fit < 8 THEN '评分未完成'::text
                    WHEN c.fit_total >= 32 THEN '适合价值投资复利框架（仍需价格安全边际）'::text
                    WHEN c.fit_total >= 22 THEN '可研究，需说明更偏复利、现金流价值还是资产价值'::text
                    ELSE '通常不符合价值投资标准'::text
                END)), (16,'C16'::text,'分部加总与股息贴现对照'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.sotp_base IS NULL THEN '通过'::text
                    WHEN abs(c.sotp_diff) > 0.25::double precision THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.sotp_base IS NULL THEN '未设置分部加总，只用股息贴现'::text
                    WHEN c.sotp_implied IS NULL AND c.seg_mature_mult IS NOT NULL THEN format('基准情景：分部加总 %s 元，股息贴现 %s 元，相差 %s（超过 25%% 时要说明差异来源，常见是股息贴现没有计入留存的现金与对外投资）；成熟业务倍数 %s 倍，市场隐含成熟业务倍数 %s 倍'::text, vi_fmt(c.sotp_base), vi_fmt(c.ddm_base), vi_pct(c.sotp_diff), vi_fmt(c.seg_mature_mult, 1), vi_fmt(c.seg_implied_mature, 1))
                    ELSE format('基准情景：分部加总 %s 元，股息贴现 %s 元，相差 %s（超过 25%% 时要说明差异来源，常见是股息贴现没有计入留存的现金与对外投资）；合理倍数 %s 倍，市场隐含核心倍数 %s 倍'::text, vi_fmt(c.sotp_base), vi_fmt(c.ddm_base), vi_pct(c.sotp_diff), vi_fmt(c.sotp_multiple, 1), vi_fmt(c.sotp_implied, 1))
                END), (17,'C17'::text,'经营分部估值'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_seg = 0 THEN '通过'::text
                    WHEN c.sotp_base IS NULL THEN '阻断'::text
                    WHEN c.prob_n > 0 AND abs(c.prob_sum - 1::double precision) > 0.005::double precision OR (c.seg_growth / NULLIF(c.seg_equity, 0::double precision)) > 0.4::double precision THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_seg = 0 THEN '未使用经营分部估值'::text
                    WHEN c.sotp_base IS NULL THEN '经营分部或分部估值项输入不完整，基准情景算不出每股价值（见「估值 / 经营分部估值」）'::text
                    ELSE format('基准情景：成熟业务 %s 亿元、成长业务 %s 亿元、投入期业务 %s 亿元、直接估值业务 %s 亿元、非经营部分 %s 亿元；成长业务占股权价值 %s（超过 40%% 时提示：价值主要取决于尚未成熟的业务）。市场隐含成长业务价值 %s 亿元。情景概率合计 %s（应为 100%%），概率加权每股 %s 元。'::text, vi_fmt(c.seg_mature, 0), vi_fmt(c.seg_growth, 0), vi_fmt(c.seg_invest, 0), vi_fmt(c.seg_direct, 0), vi_fmt(c.seg_noncore, 0), vi_pct(c.seg_growth / NULLIF(c.seg_equity, 0::double precision)), vi_fmt(c.seg_implied_growth, 0),
                    CASE
                        WHEN c.prob_n = 0 THEN '未填'::text
                        ELSE vi_pct(c.prob_sum)
                    END, vi_fmt(c.seg_weighted))
                END), (18,'C18'::text,'适配度与论点一致'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.fit_conflict IS NULL THEN '通过'::text
                    ELSE '提示'::text
                END,COALESCE(('给了 4 分以上、但关联论点是存疑或证伪的维度：'::text || c.fit_conflict) || '。要么下调评分，要么说明为什么论点存疑不影响这个维度'::text, '4 分以上的维度，关联论点都不是存疑或证伪'::text)), (19,'C19'::text,'风险分析'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_risk = 0 OR c.risk_unpriced IS NOT NULL OR c.risk_no_signal IS NOT NULL OR c.risk_incomplete IS NOT NULL THEN '提示'::text
                    ELSE '通过'::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.n_risk = 0 THEN '还没有做风险分析（商业模式 / 风险分析）'::text
                    ELSE (((format('%s 条风险（%s）'::text, c.n_risk, c.risk_mix) || COALESCE(('；重大风险未计入估值：'::text || c.risk_unpriced) || '（在悲观情景或参数里体现，或在影响测算里说明为什么不计）'::text, ''::text)) || COALESCE('；重大、重要风险缺预警信号：'::text || c.risk_no_signal, ''::text)) || COALESCE('；可能性、冲击或估值处理没填：'::text || c.risk_incomplete, ''::text)) ||
                    CASE
                        WHEN c.risk_unpriced IS NULL AND c.risk_no_signal IS NULL AND c.risk_incomplete IS NULL THEN '；重大风险都已计入估值，重大、重要风险都有预警信号'::text
                        ELSE ''::text
                    END
                END)) x(k, code, name, result, detail);

objects.view_sql:
WITH r AS (
         SELECT vi_raw_capture_base.run_id,
            count(*) AS raw_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE vi_raw_capture_base.status = '已入库'::text) AS ingested,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE vi_raw_capture_base.status = '重复未入库'::text) AS duplicates,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE vi_raw_capture_base.status = '抓取失败'::text) AS fetch_failed,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE vi_raw_capture_base.status = '校验失败'::text) AS invalid
           FROM vi_raw_capture_base
          WHERE vi_raw_capture_base.run_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY vi_raw_capture_base.run_id
        )
 SELECT b.id,
    b.created_at AS requested_at,
        CASE
            WHEN b.status = '完成'::text THEN b.updated_at
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS finished_at,
        CASE
            WHEN b.status = '完成'::text THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM b.updated_at - b.created_at))::integer
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS seconds,
    COALESCE(r.raw_count, 0::bigint)::integer AS raw_count,
    COALESCE(r.ingested, 0::bigint)::integer AS ingested,
    COALESCE(r.duplicates, 0::bigint)::integer AS duplicates,
    COALESCE(r.fetch_failed, 0::bigint)::integer AS fetch_failed,
    COALESCE(r.invalid, 0::bigint)::integer AS invalid,
        CASE
            WHEN b.status = '完成'::text THEN (((((((COALESCE(r.raw_count, 0::bigint) || ' 个数据源：新入库 '::text) || COALESCE(r.ingested, 0::bigint)) || '，重复 '::text) || COALESCE(r.duplicates, 0::bigint)) || '，抓取失败 '::text) || COALESCE(r.fetch_failed, 0::bigint)) || '，校验失败 '::text) || COALESCE(r.invalid, 0::bigint)
            WHEN (now() - b.updated_at) > '00:05:00'::interval THEN '超过 5 分钟未结束：到「设置 → 工作流 → ④ 手动采集」看执行记录'::text
            ELSE '进行中'::text
        END AS summary
   FROM vi_collect_run_base b
     LEFT JOIN r ON r.run_id = b.id;

objects.name: vi_fin_history_calc
objects.view_sql:
WITH b AS (
         SELECT h.id,
            h.year,
            h.scope_note,
            h.volume,
            h.revenue,
            h.pretax_profit,
            h.income_tax,
            h.np_parent,
            h.minority_profit,
            h.da,
            h.finance_cost,
            h.invest_income,
            h.equity_income,
            h.cfo,
            h.capex,
            h.investee_cash_div,
            h.net_borrowing,
            h.interest_debt,
            h.cash,
            h.dividend_total,
            h.dps,
            h.note,
            h.company_id,
            h.source_id,
            h.created_at,
            h.updated_at,
            h.cost_of_sales,
            h.equity_parent,
            h.revenue / NULLIF(h.volume, 0::double precision) AS price_,
            lag(h.year) OVER w AS py,
            lag(h.scope_note) OVER w AS p_scope,
            lag(h.volume) OVER w AS p_volume,
            lag(h.revenue) OVER w AS p_revenue,
            lag(h.revenue / NULLIF(h.volume, 0::double precision)) OVER w AS p_price,
            lag(h.np_parent) OVER w AS p_np,
            lag(h.finance_cost) OVER w AS p_fc,
            lag(h.equity_parent) OVER w AS p_equity
           FROM vi_fin_history_base h
          WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY h.company_id ORDER BY h.year)
        )
 SELECT id,
    price_ AS price,
    dividend_total / NULLIF(np_parent, 0::double precision) AS payout,
    income_tax / NULLIF(pretax_profit, 0::double precision) AS tax_rate,
    minority_profit / NULLIF(pretax_profit - income_tax, 0::double precision) AS minority_share,
    1::double precision - np_parent / NULLIF(pretax_profit, 0::double precision) AS burden,
    cfo - capex AS fcf,
        CASE
            WHEN py = (year - 1) AND NOT p_scope IS DISTINCT FROM scope_note THEN volume / NULLIF(p_volume, 0::double precision) - 1::double precision
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS volume_yoy,
        CASE
            WHEN py = (year - 1) AND NOT p_scope IS DISTINCT FROM scope_note THEN price_ / NULLIF(p_price, 0::double precision) - 1::double precision
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS price_yoy,
        CASE
            WHEN py = (year - 1) AND NOT p_scope IS DISTINCT FROM scope_note THEN revenue / NULLIF(p_revenue, 0::double precision) - 1::double precision
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS revenue_yoy,
        CASE
            WHEN py = (year - 1) AND NOT p_scope IS DISTINCT FROM scope_note THEN np_parent / NULLIF(p_np, 0::double precision) - 1::double precision
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS np_yoy,
        CASE
            WHEN py = (year - 1) AND NOT p_scope IS DISTINCT FROM scope_note THEN finance_cost / NULLIF(p_fc, 0::double precision) - 1::double precision
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS finance_cost_yoy,
    1::double precision - cost_of_sales / NULLIF(revenue, 0::double precision) AS gross_margin,
        CASE
            WHEN py = (year - 1) THEN np_parent / NULLIF((equity_parent + p_equity) / 2::double precision, 0::double precision)
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS roe,
    cfo / NULLIF(np_parent, 0::double precision) AS cfo_to_np,
    capex / NULLIF(cfo, 0::double precision) AS capex_to_cfo,
    interest_debt - cash AS net_debt,
    (interest_debt - cash) / NULLIF(pretax_profit + finance_cost + da, 0::double precision) AS net_debt_to_ebitda
   FROM b;

            f.operating_status,
            f.cash_status,
            f.note,
            f.model_id,
            f.created_at,
            f.updated_at,
            m.opening_debt,
            sum(f.net_borrowing) OVER w AS nb_before,
            count(*) OVER w AS n_before,
            count(f.net_borrowing) OVER w AS nb_known_before
           FROM vi_forecast_base f
             LEFT JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id
          WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY f.model_id ORDER BY f.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
        ), e AS (
         SELECT d.id,
            d.year,
            d.volume,
            d.price,
            d.cash_cost,
            d.depreciation,
            d.other_contrib,
            d.tax_rate,
            d.minority_share,
            d.payout,
            d.net_borrowing,
            d.cost_of_debt,
            d.noncash_gain_deduct,
            d.investee_cash_div,
            d.other_cash_adj,
            d.wc_increase,
            d.maint_capex,
            d.growth_capex,
            d.min_cash_topup,
            d.operating_status,
            d.cash_status,
            d.note,
            d.model_id,
            d.created_at,
            d.updated_at,
            d.opening_debt,
            d.nb_before,
            d.n_before,
            d.nb_known_before,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(d.n_before, 0::bigint) = COALESCE(d.nb_known_before, 0::bigint) THEN d.opening_debt + COALESCE(d.nb_before, 0::double precision)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS debt_open_
           FROM d
        )
 SELECT id,
    volume * price AS revenue,
    debt_open_ AS debt_open,
    debt_open_ + net_borrowing AS debt_close,
    (debt_open_ + (debt_open_ + net_borrowing)) / 2::double precision * cost_of_debt AS interest,
    depreciation * (1::double precision - minority_share) AS attrib_da,
    noncash_gain_deduct IS NOT NULL AND investee_cash_div IS NOT NULL AND other_cash_adj IS NOT NULL AND wc_increase IS NOT NULL AND maint_capex IS NOT NULL AND growth_capex IS NOT NULL AND min_cash_topup IS NOT NULL AND net_borrowing IS NOT NULL AS cash_complete
   FROM e;

objects.name: vi_projection
objects.view_sql:
WITH j AS (
         SELECT s.id AS scenario_id,
            s.model_id,
            s.name AS scenario_name,
            s.is_base,
            s.sort,
            s.volume_factor,
            s.price_factor,
            s.cost_factor,
            sc.eff_discount_rate AS r,
            m.base_year,
            m.terminal_year,
            m.shares,
            m.name AS model_name,
            co.name AS company_name,
            m.company_id,
            f.year,
            f.volume * s.volume_factor AS volume,
            f.price * s.price_factor AS price,
            f.cash_cost * s.cost_factor AS cash_cost,
            f.depreciation,
            fc.interest,
            f.other_contrib,
            f.tax_rate,
            f.minority_share,
            f.payout,
            f.net_borrowing,
            fc.debt_close,
            fc.attrib_da,
            fc.cash_complete,
            f.noncash_gain_deduct,
            f.investee_cash_div,
            f.other_cash_adj,
            f.wc_increase,
            f.maint_capex,
            f.growth_capex,
            f.min_cash_topup
           FROM vi_scenario_base s
             JOIN vi_scenario_calc sc ON sc.id = s.id
             JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = s.model_id
             LEFT JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id
             JOIN vi_forecast_base f ON f.model_id = s.model_id
             JOIN vi_forecast_calc fc ON fc.id = f.id
        ), k AS (
         SELECT j.scenario_id,
            j.model_id,
            j.scenario_name,
            j.is_base,
            j.sort,
            j.volume_factor,
            j.price_factor,
            j.cost_factor,
            j.r,
            j.base_year,
            j.terminal_year,
            j.shares,
            j.model_name,
            j.company_name,
            j.company_id,
            j.year,
            j.volume,
            j.price,
            j.cash_cost,
            j.depreciation,
            j.interest,
            j.other_contrib,
            j.tax_rate,
            j.minority_share,
            j.payout,
            j.net_borrowing,
            j.debt_close,
            j.attrib_da,
            j.cash_complete,
            j.noncash_gain_deduct,
            j.investee_cash_div,
            j.other_cash_adj,
            j.wc_increase,
            j.maint_capex,
            j.growth_capex,
            j.min_cash_topup,
            j.volume * j.price AS revenue
           FROM j
        ), l AS (
         SELECT k.scenario_id,
            k.model_id,
            k.scenario_name,
            k.is_base,
            k.sort,
            k.volume_factor,
            k.price_factor,
            k.cost_factor,
            k.r,
            k.base_year,
            k.terminal_year,
            k.shares,
            k.model_name,
            k.company_name,
            k.company_id,
            k.year,
            k.volume,
            k.price,
            k.cash_cost,
            k.depreciation,
            k.interest,
            k.other_contrib,
            k.tax_rate,
            k.minority_share,
            k.payout,
            k.net_borrowing,
            k.debt_close,
            k.attrib_da,
            k.cash_complete,
            k.noncash_gain_deduct,
            k.investee_cash_div,
            k.other_cash_adj,
            k.wc_increase,
            k.maint_capex,
            k.growth_capex,
            k.min_cash_topup,
            k.revenue,
            k.revenue - k.cash_cost - k.depreciation - k.interest + k.other_contrib AS pretax
           FROM k
        ), m AS (
         SELECT l.scenario_id,
            l.model_id,
            l.scenario_name,
            l.is_base,
            l.sort,
            l.volume_factor,
            l.price_factor,
            l.cost_factor,
            l.r,
            l.base_year,
            l.terminal_year,
            l.shares,
            l.model_name,
            l.company_name,
            l.company_id,
            l.year,
            l.volume,
            l.price,
            l.cash_cost,
            l.depreciation,
            l.interest,
            l.other_contrib,
            l.tax_rate,
            l.minority_share,
            l.payout,
            l.net_borrowing,
            l.debt_close,
            l.attrib_da,
            l.cash_complete,
            l.noncash_gain_deduct,
            l.investee_cash_div,
            l.other_cash_adj,
            l.wc_increase,
            l.maint_capex,
            l.growth_capex,
            l.min_cash_topup,
            l.revenue,
            l.pretax,
            l.pretax * l.tax_rate AS tax,
            l.pretax * (1::double precision - l.tax_rate) * l.minority_share AS minority,
            l.pretax * (1::double precision - l.tax_rate) * (1::double precision - l.minority_share) AS np_parent,
            1::double precision / power(1::double precision + l.r, (l.year - l.base_year)::double precision) AS discount_factor
           FROM l
        ), n AS (
         SELECT m.scenario_id,
            m.model_id,
            m.scenario_name,
            m.is_base,
            m.sort,
            m.volume_factor,
            m.price_factor,
            m.cost_factor,
            m.r,
            m.base_year,
            m.terminal_year,
            m.shares,
            m.model_name,
            m.company_name,
            m.company_id,
            m.year,
            m.volume,
            m.price,
            m.cash_cost,
            m.depreciation,
            m.interest,
            m.other_contrib,
            m.tax_rate,
            m.minority_share,
            m.payout,
            m.net_borrowing,
            m.debt_close,
            m.attrib_da,
            m.cash_complete,
            m.noncash_gain_deduct,
            m.investee_cash_div,
            m.other_cash_adj,
            m.wc_increase,
            m.maint_capex,
            m.growth_capex,
            m.min_cash_topup,
            m.revenue,
            m.pretax,
            m.tax,
            m.minority,
            m.np_parent,
            m.discount_factor,
            GREATEST(0::double precision, m.np_parent * m.payout) AS dividend,
                CASE
                    WHEN m.cash_complete THEN m.np_parent + m.attrib_da - m.noncash_gain_deduct + m.investee_cash_div + m.other_cash_adj - m.wc_increase - m.maint_capex
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS owner_earnings
           FROM m
        ), o AS (
         SELECT n.scenario_id,
            n.model_id,
            n.scenario_name,
            n.is_base,
            n.sort,
            n.volume_factor,
            n.price_factor,
            n.cost_factor,
            n.r,
            n.base_year,
            n.terminal_year,
            n.shares,
            n.model_name,
            n.company_name,
            n.company_id,
            n.year,
            n.volume,
            n.price,
            n.cash_cost,
            n.depreciation,
            n.interest,
            n.other_contrib,
            n.tax_rate,
            n.minority_share,
            n.payout,
            n.net_borrowing,
            n.debt_close,
            n.attrib_da,
            n.cash_complete,
            n.noncash_gain_deduct,
            n.investee_cash_div,
            n.other_cash_adj,
            n.wc_increase,
            n.maint_capex,
            n.growth_capex,
            n.min_cash_topup,
            n.revenue,
            n.pretax,
            n.tax,
            n.minority,
            n.np_parent,
            n.discount_factor,
            n.dividend,
            n.owner_earnings,
            n.owner_earnings - n.growth_capex + n.net_borrowing AS fcfe
           FROM n
        )
 SELECT scenario_id * 10000 + year AS id,
    scenario_id,
    model_id,
    company_id,
    company_name,
    model_name,
    scenario_name,
    is_base,
    sort,
    year,
    base_year,
    terminal_year,
    shares,
    volume,
    price,
    revenue,
    cash_cost,
    depreciation,
    interest,
    other_contrib,
    pretax,
    tax,
    minority,
    np_parent,
    payout,
    dividend,
    dividend / NULLIF(shares, 0::double precision) AS dps,
    r AS discount_rate,
    discount_factor,
    dividend * discount_factor AS dividend_pv,
    owner_earnings,
    fcfe,
    LEAST(dividend, GREATEST(0::double precision, fcfe - min_cash_topup)) AS cash_supported_div,
    GREATEST(0::double precision, dividend + min_cash_topup - fcfe) AS funding_gap,
    LEAST(dividend, GREATEST(0::double precision, fcfe - min_cash_topup)) * discount_factor AS cash_div_pv,
    debt_close,
    cash_complete
   FROM o;

objects.name: vi_raw_capture_calc
objects.view_sql:
WITH p AS (
         SELECT r.id,
            r.status,
            r.collected_at,
            k.metric_id,
            m.valid_min,
            m.valid_max,
            x.obs_date,
            x.value,
            x.label_ok,
                CASE
                    WHEN r.fetch_result IS NULL THEN COALESCE(length(r.raw_response), 0) > 0
                    ELSE r.fetch_result ~ '^HTTP 2[0-9]{2}'::text AND COALESCE(length(r.raw_response), 0) > 0
                END AS fetch_ok,
                CASE
                    WHEN r.fetch_result IS NULL THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN COALESCE(length(r.raw_response), 0) > 0 THEN '成功（迁移记录）'::text
                        ELSE '无响应（迁移记录）'::text
                    END
                    WHEN r.fetch_result ~ '^HTTP 2[0-9]{2}'::text AND COALESCE(length(r.raw_response), 0) > 0 THEN '成功 · HTTP '::text || substr(r.fetch_result, 6, 3)
                    WHEN r.fetch_result ~ '^HTTP 2[0-9]{2}'::text THEN '空响应 · HTTP '::text || substr(r.fetch_result, 6, 3)
                    WHEN r.fetch_result ~ '^HTTP [0-9]{3}'::text THEN '网站返回错误 · HTTP '::text || substr(r.fetch_result, 6, 3)
                    ELSE '连接失败（网络、代理或网站拒绝）· '::text || regexp_replace(btrim(substr(r.fetch_result, 5)), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)
                END AS fetch_note
           FROM vi_raw_capture_base r
             LEFT JOIN vi_collector_base k ON k.id = r.collector_id
             LEFT JOIN vi_metric_base m ON m.id = k.metric_id
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL vi_parse(k.parser, k.parser_param, r.raw_response) x(obs_date, value, label_ok) ON true
        ), v AS (
         SELECT p.id,
            p.status,
            p.collected_at,
            p.metric_id,
            p.valid_min,
            p.valid_max,
            p.obs_date,
            p.value,
            p.label_ok,
            p.fetch_ok,
            p.fetch_note,
            p.obs_date IS NOT NULL AND p.value IS NOT NULL AND p.label_ok AND ((p.collected_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'::text)::date - p.obs_date) >= 0 AND ((p.collected_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'::text)::date - p.obs_date) <= 7 AND p.value >= COALESCE(p.valid_min, '-Infinity'::double precision) AND p.value <= COALESCE(p.valid_max, 'Infinity'::double precision) AS is_valid
           FROM p
        ), w AS (
         SELECT v.id,
            v.status,
            v.collected_at,
            v.metric_id,
            v.valid_min,
            v.valid_max,
            v.obs_date,
            v.value,
            v.label_ok,
            v.fetch_ok,
            v.fetch_note,
            v.is_valid,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM vi_observation_base o
                  WHERE o.metric_id = v.metric_id AND o.obs_date = v.obs_date AND o.value = v.value)) AS already_exists,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY v.metric_id, v.obs_date, v.value, v.is_valid ORDER BY v.collected_at, v.id) AS dup_rank
           FROM v
        )
 SELECT id,
    fetch_ok,
    fetch_note,
    obs_date AS parsed_date,
    value AS parsed_value,
    is_valid,
    already_exists,
        CASE
            WHEN status = '采集中'::text THEN '采集未完成'::text
            WHEN NOT fetch_ok THEN '抓取失败'::text
            WHEN NOT is_valid THEN '校验失败'::text
            WHEN already_exists THEN '重复：已有相同观察'::text
            WHEN dup_rank > 1 THEN '重复：同批次已有相同记录'::text
            ELSE '可入库'::text
        END AS decision
   FROM w;

    ( SELECT string_agg((t.code || ' '::text) || COALESCE(t.status, '未裁决'::text), '；'::text ORDER BY t.code) AS string_agg
           FROM vi_lnk_risk_theses l
             JOIN vi_thesis_base t ON t.id = l.thesis_id
          WHERE l.risk_id = r.id) AS thesis_verdicts
   FROM vi_risk_base r
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT
                CASE r.probability
                    WHEN '高'::text THEN 3
                    WHEN '中'::text THEN 2
                    WHEN '低'::text THEN 1
                    ELSE NULL::integer
                END *
                CASE r.impact
                    WHEN '高'::text THEN 3
                    WHEN '中'::text THEN 2
                    WHEN '低'::text THEN 1
                    ELSE NULL::integer
                END AS score) s;

objects.name: vi_sensitivity
objects.view_sql:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT v_1.model_id,
            v_1.id AS scenario_id,
            v_1.discount_rate AS r0,
            v_1.terminal_growth AS g0,
            v_1.company_id,
            v_1.company_name,
            v_1.model_name,
            m.base_year AS b,
            m.terminal_year AS t,
            m.shares,
            mc.years_elapsed
           FROM vi_valuation v_1
             JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v_1.model_id
             JOIN vi_model_calc mc ON mc.id = m.id
          WHERE v_1.is_base AND v_1.years_complete
        ), grid AS (
         SELECT base.model_id,
            base.scenario_id,
            base.r0,
            base.g0,
            base.company_id,
            base.company_name,
            base.model_name,
            base.b,
            base.t,
            base.shares,
            base.years_elapsed,
            i.i,
            j.j,
            (i.i - 3)::numeric * 0.005 AS dr,
            (j.j - 3)::numeric * 0.005 AS dg
           FROM base,
            generate_series(1, 5) i(i),
            generate_series(1, 5) j(j)
        ), val AS (
         SELECT grid.model_id,
            grid.scenario_id,
            grid.r0,
            grid.g0,
            grid.company_id,
            grid.company_name,
            grid.model_name,
            grid.b,
            grid.t,
            grid.shares,
            grid.years_elapsed,
            grid.i,
            grid.j,
            grid.dr,
            grid.dg,
            grid.r0 + grid.dr::double precision AS r,
            grid.g0 + grid.dg::double precision AS g,
            ( SELECT sum(p.dividend / power(1::double precision + grid.r0 + grid.dr::double precision, (p.year - grid.b)::double precision)) AS sum
                   FROM vi_projection p
                  WHERE p.scenario_id = grid.scenario_id AND p.year >= (grid.b + 1) AND p.year <= grid.t) AS pv,
            ( SELECT p.dividend
                   FROM vi_projection p
                  WHERE p.scenario_id = grid.scenario_id AND p.year = grid.t) AS td
           FROM grid
        ), v AS (
         SELECT val.model_id,
            val.scenario_id,
            val.r0,
            val.g0,
            val.company_id,
            val.company_name,
            val.model_name,
            val.b,
            val.t,
            val.shares,
            val.years_elapsed,
            val.i,
            val.j,
            val.dr,
            val.dg,
            val.r,
            val.g,
            val.pv,
            val.td,
                CASE
                    WHEN val.r > val.g AND val.shares > 0::double precision THEN (val.pv + val.td * (1::double precision + val.g) / (val.r - val.g) / power(1::double precision + val.r, (val.t - val.b)::double precision)) / val.shares
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS v0
           FROM val
        )
 SELECT model_id * 1000 + i * 10 + j AS id,
    model_id,
    company_id,
    company_name,
    model_name,
    format('r%s / g%s'::text,
        CASE
            WHEN dr >= 0::numeric THEN '+'::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END || vi_pct(dr::double precision, 1),
        CASE
            WHEN dg >= 0::numeric THEN '+'::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END || vi_pct(dg::double precision, 1)) AS label,
    dr AS r_shift,
    dg AS g_shift,
    r,
    g,
    v0 AS value_base_date,
    v0 * power(1::double precision + r, years_elapsed::double precision) AS value_today
   FROM v;

objects.name: vi_sotp
objects.view_sql:
WITH sc AS (
         SELECT s.id AS scenario_id,
            s.model_id,
            s.name AS scenario_name,
            COALESCE(s.is_base, false) AS is_base,
            s.sort,
            x.eff_discount_rate AS r,
            s.terminal_growth AS g,
            s.ronic,
            s.sotp_multiple,
            s.probability,
            m.sotp_year,
            m.sotp_core_adj,
            m.sotp_as_of,
            m.shares,
            m.margin_low,
            m.margin_high,
            m.company_id,
            m.name AS model_name,
            co.name AS company_name,
            cc.latest_price,
            cc.latest_fx
           FROM vi_scenario_base s
             JOIN vi_scenario_calc x ON x.id = s.id
             JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = s.model_id
             LEFT JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id
             LEFT JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id
          WHERE m.sotp_year IS NOT NULL AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM vi_sotp_item_base i
                  WHERE i.model_id = m.id)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM vi_sotp_segment_base g
                  WHERE g.model_id = m.id))
        ), core AS (
         SELECT sc.scenario_id,
            sc.model_id,
            sc.scenario_name,
            sc.is_base,
            sc.sort,
            sc.r,
            sc.g,
            sc.ronic,
            sc.sotp_multiple,
            sc.probability,
            sc.sotp_year,
            sc.sotp_core_adj,
            sc.sotp_as_of,
            sc.shares,
            sc.margin_low,
            sc.margin_high,
            sc.company_id,
            sc.model_name,
            sc.company_name,
            sc.latest_price,
            sc.latest_fx,
            p.pretax - p.other_contrib + p.interest AS core_pretax,
            (p.pretax - p.other_contrib + p.interest) * p.np_parent / NULLIF(p.pretax, 0::double precision) + COALESCE(sc.sotp_core_adj, 0::double precision) AS core_earnings
           FROM sc
             LEFT JOIN vi_projection p ON p.scenario_id = sc.scenario_id AND p.year = sc.sotp_year
        ), items AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.scenario_id, i.code) c.scenario_id,
            i.kind,
            ic.signed_value
           FROM core c
             JOIN vi_sotp_item_base i ON i.model_id = c.model_id AND (i.scenario_id = c.scenario_id OR i.scenario_id IS NULL)
             JOIN vi_sotp_item_calc ic ON ic.id = i.id
          ORDER BY c.scenario_id, i.code, (i.scenario_id IS NULL)
        ), agg AS (
         SELECT items.scenario_id,
            sum(items.signed_value) FILTER (WHERE items.kind = '现金及等价物'::text) AS cash,
            sum(items.signed_value) FILTER (WHERE items.kind = '带息负债'::text) AS debt,
            sum(items.signed_value) FILTER (WHERE items.kind = '经营所需现金'::text) AS op_cash,
            sum(items.signed_value) FILTER (WHERE items.kind = '资金汇出成本'::text) AS repatriation,
            sum(items.signed_value) FILTER (WHERE items.kind = '对外投资'::text) AS investments,
            sum(items.signed_value) FILTER (WHERE items.kind = ANY (ARRAY['少数股东权益'::text, '其他调整'::text])) AS minority_other,
            sum(items.signed_value) AS noncore
           FROM items
          GROUP BY items.scenario_id
        ), segs AS (
         SELECT vi_sotp_segment_val.scenario_id,
            count(*) AS n_segments,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE vi_sotp_segment_val.value IS NULL) AS n_incomplete,
            sum(vi_sotp_segment_val.value) AS segments_value,
            sum(vi_sotp_segment_val.value) FILTER (WHERE vi_sotp_segment_val.method = '盈利×倍数'::text) AS mature_value,
            sum(vi_sotp_segment_val.earnings) FILTER (WHERE vi_sotp_segment_val.method = '盈利×倍数'::text) AS mature_earnings,
            sum(vi_sotp_segment_val.earn_pv) FILTER (WHERE vi_sotp_segment_val.method = '盈利×倍数'::text) AS mature_earn_pv,
            sum(vi_sotp_segment_val.interim_pv) FILTER (WHERE vi_sotp_segment_val.method = '盈利×倍数'::text) AS mature_interim_pv,
            sum(vi_sotp_segment_val.value) FILTER (WHERE vi_sotp_segment_val.method = '稳态折现'::text) AS growth_value,
            sum(vi_sotp_segment_val.value) FILTER (WHERE vi_sotp_segment_val.method = '承诺投入'::text) AS invest_value,
            sum(vi_sotp_segment_val.value) FILTER (WHERE vi_sotp_segment_val.method = '直接估值'::text) AS direct_value
           FROM vi_sotp_segment_val
          GROUP BY vi_sotp_segment_val.scenario_id
        ), v AS (
         SELECT core.scenario_id,
            core.model_id,
            core.scenario_name,
            core.is_base,
            core.sort,
            core.r,
            core.g,
            core.ronic,
            core.sotp_multiple,
            core.probability,
            core.sotp_year,
            core.sotp_core_adj,
            core.sotp_as_of,
            core.shares,
            core.margin_low,
            core.margin_high,
            core.company_id,
            core.model_name,
            core.company_name,
            core.latest_price,
            core.latest_fx,
            core.core_pretax,
            core.core_earnings,
            a.cash,
            a.debt,
            a.op_cash,
            a.repatriation,
            a.investments,
            a.minority_other,
            COALESCE(a.noncore, 0::double precision) AS noncore,
            COALESCE(a.cash, 0::double precision) + COALESCE(a.debt, 0::double precision) + COALESCE(a.op_cash, 0::double precision) + COALESCE(a.repatriation, 0::double precision) AS usable_net_cash,
                CASE
                    WHEN core.ronic > 0::double precision AND core.r > core.g THEN (1::double precision - core.g / core.ronic) / (core.r - core.g)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS formula_multiple,
            COALESCE(sg.n_segments, 0::bigint) AS n_segments,
            COALESCE(sg.n_incomplete, 0::bigint) AS n_incomplete,
            sg.segments_value,
            sg.mature_value,
            sg.mature_earnings,
            sg.mature_earn_pv,
            sg.mature_interim_pv,
            sg.growth_value,
            sg.invest_value,
            sg.direct_value
           FROM core
             LEFT JOIN agg a USING (scenario_id)
             LEFT JOIN segs sg USING (scenario_id)
        ), w AS (
         SELECT v.scenario_id,
            v.model_id,
            v.scenario_name,
            v.is_base,
            v.sort,
            v.r,
            v.g,
            v.ronic,
            v.sotp_multiple,
            v.probability,
            v.sotp_year,
            v.sotp_core_adj,
            v.sotp_as_of,
            v.shares,
            v.margin_low,
            v.margin_high,
            v.company_id,
            v.model_name,
            v.company_name,
            v.latest_price,
            v.latest_fx,
            v.core_pretax,
            v.core_earnings,
            v.cash,
            v.debt,
            v.op_cash,
            v.repatriation,
            v.investments,
            v.minority_other,
            v.noncore,
            v.usable_net_cash,
            v.formula_multiple,
            v.n_segments,
            v.n_incomplete,
            v.segments_value,
            v.mature_value,
            v.mature_earnings,
            v.mature_earn_pv,
            v.mature_interim_pv,
            v.growth_value,
            v.invest_value,
            v.direct_value,
            COALESCE(v.sotp_multiple, v.formula_multiple) AS multiple
           FROM v
        ), x AS (
         SELECT w.scenario_id,
            w.model_id,
            w.scenario_name,
            w.is_base,
            w.sort,
            w.r,
            w.g,
            w.ronic,
            w.sotp_multiple,
            w.probability,
            w.sotp_year,
            w.sotp_core_adj,
            w.sotp_as_of,
            w.shares,
            w.margin_low,
            w.margin_high,
            w.company_id,
            w.model_name,
            w.company_name,
            w.latest_price,
            w.latest_fx,
            w.core_pretax,
            w.core_earnings,
            w.cash,
            w.debt,
            w.op_cash,
            w.repatriation,
            w.investments,
            w.minority_other,
            w.noncore,
            w.usable_net_cash,
            w.formula_multiple,
            w.n_segments,
            w.n_incomplete,
            w.segments_value,
            w.mature_value,
            w.mature_earnings,
            w.mature_earn_pv,
            w.mature_interim_pv,
            w.growth_value,
            w.invest_value,
            w.direct_value,
            w.multiple,
            w.core_earnings * w.multiple AS core_value,
                CASE
                    WHEN w.n_incomplete = 0 AND (w.sotp_year IS NULL OR (w.core_earnings * w.multiple) IS NOT NULL) THEN COALESCE(w.core_earnings * w.multiple, 0::double precision) + COALESCE(w.segments_value, 0::double precision) + w.noncore
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS equity_value
           FROM w
        ), y AS (
         SELECT x.scenario_id,
            x.model_id,
            x.scenario_name,
            x.is_base,
            x.sort,
            x.r,
            x.g,
            x.ronic,
            x.sotp_multiple,
            x.probability,
            x.sotp_year,
            x.sotp_core_adj,
            x.sotp_as_of,
            x.shares,
            x.margin_low,
            x.margin_high,
            x.company_id,
            x.model_name,
            x.company_name,
            x.latest_price,
            x.latest_fx,
            x.core_pretax,
            x.core_earnings,
            x.cash,
            x.debt,
            x.op_cash,
            x.repatriation,
            x.investments,
            x.minority_other,
            x.noncore,
            x.usable_net_cash,
            x.formula_multiple,
            x.n_segments,
            x.n_incomplete,
            x.segments_value,
            x.mature_value,
            x.mature_earnings,
            x.mature_earn_pv,
            x.mature_interim_pv,
            x.growth_value,
            x.invest_value,
            x.direct_value,
            x.multiple,
            x.core_value,
            x.equity_value,
            x.equity_value / NULLIF(x.shares, 0::double precision) AS vps,
            x.latest_price * x.shares AS mcap
           FROM x
        ), z AS (
         SELECT y.scenario_id,
            y.model_id,
            y.scenario_name,
            y.is_base,
            y.sort,
            y.r,
            y.g,
            y.ronic,
            y.sotp_multiple,
            y.probability,
            y.sotp_year,
            y.sotp_core_adj,
            y.sotp_as_of,
            y.shares,
            y.margin_low,
            y.margin_high,
            y.company_id,
            y.model_name,
            y.company_name,
            y.latest_price,
            y.latest_fx,
            y.core_pretax,
            y.core_earnings,
            y.cash,
            y.debt,
            y.op_cash,
            y.repatriation,
            y.investments,
            y.minority_other,
            y.noncore,
            y.usable_net_cash,
            y.formula_multiple,
            y.n_segments,
            y.n_incomplete,
            y.segments_value,
            y.mature_value,
            y.mature_earnings,
            y.mature_earn_pv,
            y.mature_interim_pv,
            y.growth_value,
            y.invest_value,
            y.direct_value,
            y.multiple,
            y.core_value,
            y.equity_value,
            y.vps,
            y.mcap,
                CASE
                    WHEN count(*) OVER pm = count(y.probability) OVER pm AND count(*) OVER pm = count(y.vps) OVER pm THEN sum(y.probability * y.vps) OVER pm / NULLIF(sum(y.probability) OVER pm, 0::double precision)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS weighted_value,
                CASE
                    WHEN y.mature_earn_pv > 0::double precision THEN (y.mcap - y.noncore - COALESCE(y.core_value, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(y.growth_value, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(y.invest_value, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(y.direct_value, 0::double precision) - y.mature_interim_pv) / y.mature_earn_pv
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS implied_mature_multiple,
                CASE
                    WHEN y.growth_value IS NOT NULL THEN y.mcap - y.noncore - COALESCE(y.core_value, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(y.mature_value, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(y.invest_value, 0::double precision) - COALESCE(y.direct_value, 0::double precision)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS implied_growth_value,
            (y.mature_value - y.mature_interim_pv) / NULLIF(y.mature_earn_pv, 0::double precision) AS mature_multiple
           FROM y
          WINDOW pm AS (PARTITION BY y.model_id)
        )
 SELECT z.scenario_id AS id,
    z.model_id,
    z.company_id,
    z.company_name,
    z.model_name,
    z.scenario_name,
    z.is_base,
    z.sort,
    z.sotp_year AS core_year,
    z.sotp_as_of AS as_of,
    z.core_pretax,
    z.core_earnings,

    z.core_value,

    z.mature_value,
    z.mature_earnings,
    z.mature_multiple,
    z.growth_value,
    z.invest_value,
    z.direct_value,
    z.mature_earn_pv,
    z.mature_interim_pv,
    z.cash,
    z.debt,
    z.op_cash,
    z.repatriation,
    z.usable_net_cash,
    z.investments,
    z.minority_other,
    z.noncore,
    z.equity_value,
    z.shares,
    z.vps AS value_per_share,
    z.vps / NULLIF(z.latest_fx, 0::double precision) AS value_per_share_quote,
    z.latest_price AS market_price,
    z.latest_price / NULLIF(z.vps, 0::double precision) - 1::double precision AS price_vs_value,
    (z.mcap - z.noncore - COALESCE(z.segments_value, 0::double precision)) / NULLIF(z.core_earnings, 0::double precision) AS implied_core_multiple,
    z.implied_mature_multiple,
    z.implied_growth_value,
    z.probability,
    z.weighted_value,
    dv.value_today AS ddm_value,
    z.vps / NULLIF(dv.value_today, 0::double precision) - 1::double precision AS diff_vs_ddm,
    z.vps * (1::double precision - z.margin_low) AS watch_low,
    z.vps * (1::double precision - z.margin_high) AS watch_high,
        CASE
            WHEN z.sotp_year IS NOT NULL AND z.core_earnings IS NULL THEN format('预测计算里没有 %s 年的数据，核心盈利无法计算'::text, z.sotp_year)
            WHEN z.sotp_year IS NOT NULL AND z.multiple IS NULL THEN '没有合理倍数：在情景里填“合理倍数”或“新增投资回报率”'::text
            WHEN z.n_incomplete > 0 THEN format('经营分部有 %s 项输入不完整，无法计算（见「估值 / 经营分部估值」）'::text, z.n_incomplete)
            WHEN z.n_segments = 0 THEN format('核心盈利 %s 亿元（%s 年）× 合理倍数 %s 倍 ＝ %s 亿元；可用净现金 %s 亿元；对外投资（折后）%s 亿元；少数股东权益与其他 %s 亿元；股权价值 %s 亿元，每股 %s 元%s。市场价 %s 元，%s；市场给核心业务的隐含倍数 %s 倍。股息贴现口径 %s 元。'::text, vi_fmt(z.core_earnings, 1), z.sotp_year, vi_fmt(z.multiple, 1), vi_fmt(z.core_value, 0), vi_fmt(z.usable_net_cash, 0), vi_fmt(z.investments, 0), vi_fmt(z.minority_other, 0), vi_fmt(z.equity_value, 0), vi_fmt(z.vps),
            CASE
                WHEN z.latest_fx IS NOT NULL THEN format('（约合股价币种 %s）'::text, vi_fmt(z.vps / z.latest_fx))
                ELSE ''::text
            END, vi_fmt(z.latest_price),
            CASE
                WHEN z.latest_price IS NULL THEN '暂无市场价'::text
                WHEN z.latest_price > z.vps THEN format('高于每股价值 %s'::text, vi_pct(z.latest_price / z.vps - 1::double precision))
                ELSE format('低于每股价值 %s'::text, vi_pct(1::double precision - z.latest_price / z.vps))
            END, vi_fmt((z.mcap - z.noncore) / NULLIF(z.core_earnings, 0::double precision), 1), vi_fmt(dv.value_today))
            ELSE format('%s经营分部合计 %s 亿元（成熟业务 %s、成长业务 %s、投入期业务 %s、直接估值业务 %s）；可用净现金 %s 亿元；对外投资（折后）%s 亿元；少数股东权益与其他 %s 亿元；股权价值 %s 亿元，每股 %s 元%s。市场价 %s 元，%s。%s%s%s股息贴现口径 %s 元。'::text,
            CASE
                WHEN z.core_earnings IS NOT NULL THEN format('核心盈利 %s 亿元（%s 年）× %s 倍 ＝ %s 亿元；'::text, vi_fmt(z.core_earnings, 1), z.sotp_year, vi_fmt(z.multiple, 1), vi_fmt(z.core_value, 0))
                ELSE ''::text
            END, vi_fmt(z.segments_value, 0), vi_fmt(COALESCE(z.mature_value, 0::double precision), 0), vi_fmt(COALESCE(z.growth_value, 0::double precision), 0), vi_fmt(COALESCE(z.invest_value, 0::double precision), 0), vi_fmt(COALESCE(z.direct_value, 0::double precision), 0), vi_fmt(z.usable_net_cash, 0), vi_fmt(z.investments, 0), vi_fmt(z.minority_other, 0), vi_fmt(z.equity_value, 0), vi_fmt(z.vps),
            CASE
                WHEN z.latest_fx IS NOT NULL THEN format('（约合股价币种 %s）'::text, vi_fmt(z.vps / z.latest_fx))
                ELSE ''::text
            END, vi_fmt(z.latest_price),
            CASE
                WHEN z.latest_price IS NULL THEN '暂无市场价'::text
                WHEN z.latest_price > z.vps THEN format('高于每股价值 %s'::text, vi_pct(z.latest_price / z.vps - 1::double precision))
                ELSE format('低于每股价值 %s'::text, vi_pct(1::double precision - z.latest_price / z.vps))
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN z.implied_mature_multiple IS NOT NULL THEN format('其余部分按本模型取值时，市值对应成熟业务约 %s 倍正常化盈利（本模型 %s 倍）；'::text, vi_fmt(z.implied_mature_multiple, 1), vi_fmt(z.mature_multiple, 1))
                ELSE ''::text
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN z.implied_growth_value IS NOT NULL THEN format('或者说，市场为成长业务付了约 %s 亿元（本模型 %s 亿元）。'::text, vi_fmt(z.implied_growth_value, 0), vi_fmt(z.growth_value, 0))
                ELSE ''::text
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN z.weighted_value IS NOT NULL THEN format('按情景概率加权，每股 %s 元。'::text, vi_fmt(z.weighted_value))
                ELSE ''::text
            END, vi_fmt(dv.value_today))
        END || ' 研究提示，不是交易指令。'::text AS conclusion
   FROM z
     LEFT JOIN vi_valuation dv ON dv.id = z.scenario_id;

objects.name: vi_sotp_segment_val
objects.view_sql:
WITH pick AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.id, g.code) s.id AS scenario_id,
            s.model_id,
            s.name AS scenario_name,
            COALESCE(s.is_base, false) AS is_base,
            g.id AS segment_id,
            g.code,
            g.name,
            g.method,
            g.earn_year,
            g.revenue,
            g.op_margin,
            COALESCE(g.tax_rate, 0::double precision) AS tax_rate,
            COALESCE(g.attrib, 1::double precision) AS attrib,
            g.multiple,
            COALESCE(g.ronic, s.ronic) AS ronic,
            COALESCE(g.growth, s.terminal_growth) AS growth,
            COALESCE(g.discount_rate, x.eff_discount_rate) AS r,
            COALESCE(g.interim_cash, 0::double precision) AS interim_cash,
            COALESCE(g.commit_amount, 0::double precision) AS commit_amount,
            g.commit_years,
            COALESCE(g.ongoing_cost, 0::double precision) AS ongoing_cost,
            g.direct_value,
            m.sotp_as_of AS as_of
           FROM vi_scenario_base s
             JOIN vi_scenario_calc x ON x.id = s.id
             JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = s.model_id
             JOIN vi_sotp_segment_base g ON g.model_id = s.model_id AND (g.scenario_id = s.id OR g.scenario_id IS NULL)
          ORDER BY s.id, g.code, (g.scenario_id IS NULL)
        ), a AS (
         SELECT pick.scenario_id,
            pick.model_id,
            pick.scenario_name,
            pick.is_base,
            pick.segment_id,
            pick.code,
            pick.name,
            pick.method,
            pick.earn_year,
            pick.revenue,
            pick.op_margin,
            pick.tax_rate,
            pick.attrib,
            pick.multiple,
            pick.ronic,
            pick.growth,
            pick.r,
            pick.interim_cash,
            pick.commit_amount,
            pick.commit_years,
            pick.ongoing_cost,
            pick.direct_value,
            pick.as_of,
                CASE
                    WHEN pick.method = '承诺投入'::text THEN (- pick.ongoing_cost) * (1::double precision - pick.tax_rate) * pick.attrib
                    WHEN pick.method = '直接估值'::text THEN NULL::double precision
                    ELSE pick.revenue * pick.op_margin * (1::double precision - pick.tax_rate) * pick.attrib
                END AS earnings,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pick.method = ANY (ARRAY['盈利×倍数'::text, '稳态折现'::text])) AND pick.ronic > 0::double precision AND pick.r > pick.growth THEN (1::double precision - pick.growth / pick.ronic) / (pick.r - pick.growth)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS formula_multiple,
                CASE
                    WHEN pick.method = '承诺投入'::text THEN pick.commit_years
                    WHEN pick.method = '直接估值'::text THEN 0::double precision
                    ELSE GREATEST(0::double precision, ((make_date(pick.earn_year - 1, 12, 31) - pick.as_of)::numeric / 365.25)::double precision)
                END AS tau
           FROM pick
        ), b AS (
         SELECT a.scenario_id,
            a.model_id,
            a.scenario_name,
            a.is_base,
            a.segment_id,
            a.code,
            a.name,
            a.method,
            a.earn_year,
            a.revenue,
            a.op_margin,
            a.tax_rate,
            a.attrib,
            a.multiple,
            a.ronic,
            a.growth,
            a.r,
            a.interim_cash,
            a.commit_amount,
            a.commit_years,
            a.ongoing_cost,
            a.direct_value,
            a.as_of,
            a.earnings,
            a.formula_multiple,
            a.tau,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.method = ANY (ARRAY['盈利×倍数'::text, '稳态折现'::text]) THEN COALESCE(a.multiple, a.formula_multiple)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS multiple_used
           FROM a
        ), c AS (
         SELECT b.scenario_id,
            b.model_id,
            b.scenario_name,
            b.is_base,
            b.segment_id,
            b.code,
            b.name,
            b.method,
            b.earn_year,
            b.revenue,
            b.op_margin,
            b.tax_rate,
            b.attrib,
            b.multiple,
            b.ronic,
            b.growth,
            b.r,
            b.interim_cash,
            b.commit_amount,
            b.commit_years,
            b.ongoing_cost,
            b.direct_value,
            b.as_of,
            b.earnings,
            b.formula_multiple,
            b.tau,
            b.multiple_used,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.method = '承诺投入'::text THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN b.ongoing_cost = 0::double precision THEN 0::double precision
                        WHEN b.r > b.growth AND b.tau IS NOT NULL THEN (- b.ongoing_cost) * (1::double precision - b.tax_rate) * b.attrib / (b.r - b.growth) / power(1::double precision + b.r, b.tau)
                        ELSE NULL::double precision
                    END
                    WHEN b.method = '直接估值'::text THEN b.direct_value
                    ELSE b.earnings * b.multiple_used / power(1::double precision + b.r, b.tau)
                END AS terminal_pv,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.method = '承诺投入'::text THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN b.commit_amount = 0::double precision THEN 0::double precision
                        WHEN b.tau > 0::double precision AND b.r > 0::double precision THEN (- (b.commit_amount / b.tau)) * (1::double precision - b.tax_rate) * b.attrib * (1::double precision - power(1::double precision + b.r, - b.tau)) / b.r
                        ELSE NULL::double precision
                    END
                    WHEN b.method = '直接估值'::text THEN 0::double precision
                    ELSE b.interim_cash / power(1::double precision + b.r, b.tau / 2::double precision)
                END AS interim_pv,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.method = ANY (ARRAY['盈利×倍数'::text, '稳态折现'::text]) THEN b.earnings / power(1::double precision + b.r, b.tau)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS earn_pv
           FROM b
        )
 SELECT scenario_id * 100000 + segment_id AS id,
    scenario_id,
    model_id,
    scenario_name,
    is_base,
    segment_id,
    code,
    name,
    method,
    earn_year,
    revenue,
    op_margin,
    tax_rate,
    attrib,
    r,
    growth,
    ronic,
    earnings,
    formula_multiple,
    multiple_used,
    tau,
    interim_cash,
    commit_amount,
    commit_years,
    ongoing_cost,
    direct_value,
    terminal_pv,
    interim_pv,
    earn_pv,
    terminal_pv + interim_pv AS value
   FROM c;
