objects.name: vi_trial_calc
objects.view_sql:
WITH t AS (
         SELECT tr.id,
            tr.model_id,
            COALESCE(tr.start_year, 0) AS sy,
            COALESCE(tr.end_year, 0) AS ey,
            COALESCE(tr.volume_delta, 0::double precision) AS dv,
            COALESCE(tr.price_delta, 0::double precision) AS dp,
            COALESCE(tr.cost_delta, 0::double precision) AS dc,
            COALESCE(tr.da_delta, 0::double precision) AS dd,
            COALESCE(tr.interest_delta, 0::double precision) AS di,
            COALESCE(tr.rate_delta, 0::double precision) AS drt,
            v_1.id AS scenario_id,
            v_1.discount_rate + COALESCE(tr.rate_delta, 0::double precision) AS r,
            v_1.terminal_growth AS g,
            v_1.value_base_date AS base_value,
            m.base_year AS b,
            m.terminal_year AS tyear,
            m.shares
           FROM vi_trial_base tr
             JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = tr.model_id
             JOIN vi_valuation v_1 ON v_1.model_id = tr.model_id AND v_1.is_base
        ), d AS (
         SELECT t.id,
            p.year,
            GREATEST(0::double precision, p.dividend +
                CASE
                    WHEN p.year >= t.sy AND p.year <= t.ey THEN (p.revenue * ((1::double precision + t.dv) * (1::double precision + t.dp) - 1::double precision) - t.dc - t.dd - t.di) * (1::double precision - p.tax_rate_) * (1::double precision - p.minority_share_) * p.payout
                    ELSE 0::double precision
                END) AS div
           FROM t
             JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT pj.id,
                    pj.scenario_id,
                    pj.model_id,
                    pj.company_id,
                    pj.company_name,
                    pj.model_name,
                    pj.scenario_name,
                    pj.is_base,
                    pj.sort,
                    pj.year,
                    pj.base_year,
                    pj.terminal_year,
                    pj.shares,
                    pj.volume,
                    pj.price,
                    pj.revenue,
                    pj.cash_cost,
                    pj.depreciation,
                    pj.interest,
                    pj.other_contrib,
                    pj.pretax,
                    pj.tax,
                    pj.minority,
                    pj.np_parent,
                    pj.payout,
                    pj.dividend,
                    pj.dps,
                    pj.discount_rate,
                    pj.discount_factor,
                    pj.dividend_pv,
                    pj.owner_earnings,
                    pj.fcfe,
                    pj.cash_supported_div,
                    pj.funding_gap,
                    pj.cash_div_pv,
                    pj.debt_close,
                    pj.cash_complete,
                    f.tax_rate AS tax_rate_,
                    f.minority_share AS minority_share_
                   FROM vi_projection pj
                     JOIN vi_forecast_base f ON f.model_id = pj.model_id AND f.year = pj.year
                  WHERE pj.scenario_id = t.scenario_id AND pj.year >= (t.b + 1) AND pj.year <= t.tyear) p ON true
        ), s AS (
         SELECT t.id,
            t.model_id,
            t.sy,
            t.ey,
            t.dv,
            t.dp,
            t.dc,
            t.dd,
            t.di,
            t.drt,
            t.scenario_id,
            t.r,
            t.g,
            t.base_value,
            t.b,
            t.tyear,
            t.shares,
            ( SELECT sum(d.div / power(1::double precision + t.r, (d.year - t.b)::double precision)) AS sum
                   FROM d
                  WHERE d.id = t.id) AS pv,
            ( SELECT d.div
                   FROM d
                  WHERE d.id = t.id AND d.year = t.tyear) AS td
           FROM t
        ), v AS (
         SELECT s.id,
            s.model_id,
            s.sy,
            s.ey,
            s.dv,
            s.dp,
            s.dc,
            s.dd,
            s.di,
            s.drt,
            s.scenario_id,
            s.r,
            s.g,
            s.base_value,
            s.b,
            s.tyear,
            s.shares,
            s.pv,
            s.td,
                CASE
                    WHEN s.r > s.g AND s.shares > 0::double precision THEN (s.pv + s.td * (1::double precision + s.g) / (s.r - s.g) / power(1::double precision + s.r, (s.tyear - s.b)::double precision)) / s.shares
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS tv
           FROM s
        )
 SELECT id,
    base_value,
    tv AS trial_value,
    tv - base_value AS value_change,
    (tv - base_value) / NULLIF(base_value, 0::double precision) AS change_pct
   FROM v;

objects.name: vi_valuation
objects.view_sql:
WITH a AS (
         SELECT s.id,
            s.model_id,
            s.name AS scenario_name,
            COALESCE(s.is_base, false) AS is_base,
            s.sort,
            sc.eff_discount_rate AS r,
            s.terminal_growth AS g,
            m.base_year AS b,
            m.terminal_year AS t,
            m.shares,
            m.margin_low,
            m.margin_high,
            m.name AS model_name,
            m.company_id,
            co.name AS company_name,
            cc.latest_price,
            cc.latest_price_date,
            mc.years_elapsed,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_projection p
                  WHERE p.scenario_id = s.id AND p.year >= (m.base_year + 1) AND p.year <= m.terminal_year AND p.np_parent IS NOT NULL) AS n_years,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM vi_projection p
                  WHERE p.scenario_id = s.id AND p.year >= (m.base_year + 1) AND p.year <= m.terminal_year AND p.cash_supported_div IS NOT NULL) AS cash_years,
            ( SELECT sum(p.dividend_pv) AS sum
                   FROM vi_projection p
                  WHERE p.scenario_id = s.id AND p.year >= (m.base_year + 1) AND p.year <= m.terminal_year) AS pv_explicit,
            ( SELECT sum(p.cash_div_pv) AS sum
                   FROM vi_projection p
                  WHERE p.scenario_id = s.id AND p.year >= (m.base_year + 1) AND p.year <= m.terminal_year) AS cash_pv,
            ( SELECT p.dividend
                   FROM vi_projection p
                  WHERE p.scenario_id = s.id AND p.year = m.terminal_year) AS terminal_div,
            ( SELECT p.cash_supported_div
                   FROM vi_projection p
                  WHERE p.scenario_id = s.id AND p.year = m.terminal_year) AS terminal_cash_div
           FROM vi_scenario_base s
             JOIN vi_scenario_calc sc ON sc.id = s.id
             JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = s.model_id
             JOIN vi_model_calc mc ON mc.id = m.id
             LEFT JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id
             LEFT JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id
        ), b AS (
         SELECT a.id,
            a.model_id,
            a.scenario_name,
            a.is_base,
            a.sort,
            a.r,
            a.g,
            a.b,
            a.t,
            a.shares,
            a.margin_low,
            a.margin_high,
            a.model_name,
            a.company_id,
            a.company_name,
            a.latest_price,
            a.latest_price_date,
            a.years_elapsed,
            a.n_years,
            a.cash_years,
            a.pv_explicit,
            a.cash_pv,
            a.terminal_div,
            a.terminal_cash_div,
            a.n_years = (a.t - a.b) AS complete,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.r > a.g THEN a.terminal_div * (1::double precision + a.g) / (a.r - a.g) / power(1::double precision + a.r, (a.t - a.b)::double precision)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS terminal_pv,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.r > a.g THEN a.terminal_cash_div * (1::double precision + a.g) / (a.r - a.g) / power(1::double precision + a.r, (a.t - a.b)::double precision)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS terminal_cash_pv
           FROM a
        ), c AS (
         SELECT b.id,
            b.model_id,
            b.scenario_name,
            b.is_base,
            b.sort,
            b.r,
            b.g,
            b.b,
            b.t,
            b.shares,
            b.margin_low,
            b.margin_high,
            b.model_name,
            b.company_id,
            b.company_name,
            b.latest_price,
            b.latest_price_date,
            b.years_elapsed,
            b.n_years,
            b.cash_years,
            b.pv_explicit,
            b.cash_pv,
            b.terminal_div,
            b.terminal_cash_div,
            b.complete,
            b.terminal_pv,
            b.terminal_cash_pv,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.complete AND b.r > b.g AND b.shares > 0::double precision THEN (b.pv_explicit + b.terminal_pv) / b.shares
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS v0,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.cash_years = (b.t - b.b) AND b.r > b.g AND b.shares > 0::double precision THEN (b.cash_pv + b.terminal_cash_pv) / b.shares
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS cv0
           FROM b
        ), d AS (
         SELECT c.id,
            c.model_id,
            c.scenario_name,
            c.is_base,
            c.sort,
            c.r,
            c.g,
            c.b,
            c.t,
            c.shares,
            c.margin_low,
            c.margin_high,
            c.model_name,
            c.company_id,
            c.company_name,
            c.latest_price,
            c.latest_price_date,
            c.years_elapsed,
            c.n_years,
            c.cash_years,
            c.pv_explicit,
            c.cash_pv,
            c.terminal_div,
            c.terminal_cash_div,
            c.complete,
            c.terminal_pv,
            c.terminal_cash_pv,
            c.v0,
            c.cv0,
            c.v0 * power(1::double precision + c.r, c.years_elapsed::double precision) AS v1,
            c.cv0 * power(1::double precision + c.r, c.years_elapsed::double precision) AS cv1,
            f.required_return AS req,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.complete THEN vi_pv(f.divs, f.taus::double precision[], f.td, f.ttau::double precision, c.g, f.required_return)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS v_req,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.complete THEN vi_irr(f.divs, f.taus::double precision[], f.td, f.ttau::double precision, c.g, c.latest_price)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS irr,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.cash_years = (c.t - c.b) THEN vi_irr(f.cash_divs, f.taus::double precision[], f.tcd, f.ttau::double precision, c.g, c.latest_price)
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END AS cash_irr
           FROM c
             LEFT JOIN vi_valuation_cf f ON f.scenario_id = c.id
        )
 SELECT id,
    model_id,
    company_id,
    company_name,
    model_name,
    scenario_name,
    is_base,
    sort,
    r AS discount_rate,
    g AS terminal_growth,
    v0 AS value_base_date,
    v1 AS value_today,
    cv1 AS cash_value_today,
    pv_explicit,
    terminal_pv,
    terminal_pv / NULLIF(pv_explicit + terminal_pv, 0::double precision) AS terminal_share,
    latest_price AS market_price,
    latest_price_date AS market_date,
    latest_price / NULLIF(v1, 0::double precision) - 1::double precision AS price_vs_value,
    v1 * (1::double precision - margin_low) AS watch_low,
    v1 * (1::double precision - margin_high) AS watch_high,
    complete AS years_complete,
    cash_years::integer AS cash_years,
    req AS required_return,
    v_req AS value_at_required,
    irr AS implied_irr,
    cash_irr AS cash_implied_irr,
    irr - req AS irr_spread,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT complete THEN format('预测年份不完整：需要 %s—%s 年共 %s 年，现有 %s 年'::text, b + 1, t, t - b, n_years)
            WHEN r <= g THEN '折现率不大于永续增长率，不输出价值'::text
            ELSE
            CASE
                WHEN irr IS NULL OR req IS NULL THEN ''::text
                ELSE format('按市场价 %s 元买入，隐含年化收益率 %s（现金支持口径 %s），%s要求收益率 %s；按要求收益率的最高买入价 %s 元。'::text, vi_fmt(latest_price), vi_pct(irr, 2), vi_pct(cash_irr, 2),
                CASE
                    WHEN irr >= req THEN '达到'::text
                    ELSE '低于'::text
                END, vi_pct(req, 1), vi_fmt(v_req))
            END || format('今天每股价值 %s 元（基准日 %s 元按 %s 滚动 %s 年）。%s%s'::text, vi_fmt(v1), vi_fmt(v0), vi_pct(r, 2), round(years_elapsed, 2),
            CASE
                WHEN latest_price IS NULL THEN '暂无市场价。'::text
                WHEN latest_price > v1 THEN format('市场价 %s 元，高于今天价值 %s。'::text, vi_fmt(latest_price), vi_pct(latest_price / v1 - 1::double precision))
                WHEN latest_price > (v1 * (1::double precision - margin_low)) THEN format('市场价 %s 元，低于今天价值 %s，但未到低档关注价 %s 元。'::text, vi_fmt(latest_price), vi_pct(1::double precision - latest_price / v1), vi_fmt(v1 * (1::double precision - margin_low)))
                WHEN latest_price > (v1 * (1::double precision - margin_high)) THEN format('市场价 %s 元，已低于低档关注价 %s 元。'::text, vi_fmt(latest_price), vi_fmt(v1 * (1::double precision - margin_low)))
                ELSE format('市场价 %s 元，已低于高档关注价 %s 元。'::text, vi_fmt(latest_price), vi_fmt(v1 * (1::double precision - margin_high)))
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN cv1 IS NULL THEN '现金桥接不完整，现金支持价值不输出。'::text
                WHEN cv1 < v1 THEN format('现金支持价值 %s 元低于股息贴现价值，部分年份 FCFE 不足以支付计划股息。'::text, vi_fmt(cv1))
                ELSE ''::text
            END)
        END || ' 研究提示，不是交易指令。'::text AS conclusion
   FROM d;

objects.name: vi_valuation_cf
objects.view_sql:
SELECT s.id AS scenario_id,
    s.model_id,
    s.terminal_growth AS cf_g,
    m.required_return,
    mc.years_elapsed AS cf_elapsed,
    array_agg(p.dividend / NULLIF(m.shares, 0::double precision) ORDER BY p.year) AS divs,
    array_agg(p.cash_supported_div / NULLIF(m.shares, 0::double precision) ORDER BY p.year) AS cash_divs,
    array_agg((p.year - m.base_year)::numeric - mc.years_elapsed ORDER BY p.year) AS taus,
    max(p.dividend / NULLIF(m.shares, 0::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE p.year = m.terminal_year) AS td,
    max(p.cash_supported_div / NULLIF(m.shares, 0::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE p.year = m.terminal_year) AS tcd,
    (m.terminal_year - m.base_year)::numeric - mc.years_elapsed AS ttau
   FROM vi_scenario_base s
     JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = s.model_id
     JOIN vi_model_calc mc ON mc.id = m.id
     JOIN vi_projection p ON p.scenario_id = s.id AND p.year >= (m.base_year + 1) AND p.year <= m.terminal_year
  GROUP BY s.id, s.model_id, s.terminal_growth, m.required_return, mc.years_elapsed, m.terminal_year, m.base_year;

objects.name: vi_watch_calc
objects.view_sql:
SELECT w.id,
    l.value AS latest_value,
    l.obs_date AS latest_date
   FROM vi_watch_base w
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.value,
            x.obs_date
           FROM vi_obs_current x
          WHERE x.metric_id = w.metric_id
          ORDER BY x.obs_date DESC
         LIMIT 1) l ON true;
